note: Triennial election of the nineteen electoral divisions of Kilkeel rural district, one member each, polled in County Down on 25 May 1933. Four divisions were contested (Ballymartin, Kilkeel North, Maghera, Rostrevor); in the other fifteen the sole nominee was returned unopposed. Majority 23. The Newry Telegraph (27 May 1933, p. 8) prints M'Conville 154 and a majority of 24; the News-Letter figure (153), which agrees with the majority of 23 in the Newry Reporter, is kept.
